fragrances.name: Nautica Voyage
fragrances.description: A crisp green-apple and watery lotus scent resting on soft cedar and musk. Easygoing, clean and unpretentious, it is the classic cheap summer daily driver.
pros: Very cheap for a large bottle

fragrances.name: Cool Water
fragrances.description: The original blue aquatic fougere: minty lavender and cool sea air over a mossy, musky wood base. Brisk and clean, with a slightly retro feel.

fragrances.name: CK One
fragrances.description: A breezy citrus-and-tea cologne with soft musk that evokes fresh laundry and a crisp white shirt. Deliberately genderless and relaxed.

fragrances.name: Versace Pour Homme
fragrances.description: A bright, polished Mediterranean citrus-aromatic with a touch of herbs and a soft ambery musk. Smart, clean and effortless for daytime.

fragrances.name: Legend
fragrances.description: A modern, slightly soapy fougere of lavender, apple and pineapple over smooth tonka. Friendly, safe and easy to wear almost anywhere.

fragrances.name: Explorer
fragrances.description: A dry, woody-leathery aromatic built on vetiver and patchouli with a peppery bergamot lift. It gives a niche-style 'successful man' woody feel at designer money.

fragrances.name: Club de Nuit Intense Man
fragrances.description: A loud, smoky-lemony blend of pineapple and birch that trades polish for sheer power. Bold and confident, and a legendary budget alternative to a famous niche scent.

fragrances.name: Hawas for Him
fragrances.description: A sweet, juicy aquatic of apple, plum and cardamom over ambergris. Slick and youthful, and built to be noticed even in heat.
pros: Great club scent on a budget

fragrances.name: 9pm
fragrances.description: A warm, sugary vanilla-amber with spiced apple and lavender, made for nights out. Plush, sweet and attention-grabbing.
pros: Excellent party scent for the money
cons: Too sweet for daytime or heat

fragrances.name: Asad
fragrances.description: A peppery, ambery vanilla with shades of tobacco and coffee. Dark, spicy-sweet and punchy, suited to cold evenings.
pros: Spicy amber richness for pocket change

fragrances.name: Khamrah
fragrances.description: A boozy-feeling gourmand of cinnamon, dates and praline melting into vanilla and resins. Rich, festive and dessert-like, perfect for cold nights.
pros: Luxurious gourmand feel for little money
Cosy and comforting in the cold

fragrances.name: Yara
fragrances.description: A creamy, milky-sweet vanilla with powdery heliotrope and a soft tropical-fruit twist. Cuddly, girly and very comforting.

fragrances.name: Bade'e Al Oud Oud for Glory
fragrances.description: A smoky, saffron-spiced oud with lavender and earthy patchouli. Dark, resinous and very powerful, channelling a far pricier niche oud.
pros: Serious oud character on a budget
cons: Medicinal oud can put newcomers off

fragrances.name: Amber Oud Gold Edition
fragrances.description: A radiant sweet-fruity amber of melon and pineapple over vanilla musk. Loud, sunny and syrupy, with little actual oud despite the name.
cons: Pricier than most Middle Eastern alternatives

fragrances.name: Joop! Homme
fragrances.description: A syrupy, cinnamon-dusted orange blossom and vanilla powerhouse from the late eighties. Unapologetically sweet, loud and nostalgic.

fragrances.name: Eros
fragrances.description: Candy-like mint and green apple over creamy vanilla and tonka. Flashy and youthful, made to turn heads in clubs and on dates.

fragrances.name: Red Temptation
fragrances.description: An airy, glowing saffron-amber with a sweet praline edge, widely seen as a high-street take on a famous niche 'burnt sugar and saffron' scent. Modern and radiant.
pros: Luxury amber vibe for very little
cons: Can turn sharp on some skin

fragrances.name: Cloud
fragrances.description: A fluffy, creamy gourmand of whipped cream, coconut and praline, lifted by lavender and pear. Soft, sweet and dreamy.
pros: Very affordable and easy to find

fragrances.name: Fantasy
fragrances.description: A playful candy-shop mix of kiwi, lychee and cupcake frosting over soft musk. Unabashedly sugary and flirtatious.
pros: Good longevity for a celebrity scent
cons: Out of place in formal settings

fragrances.name: Green Tea
fragrances.description: A zesty lemon-mint splash around a slightly bitter green tea heart and a whisper of musk. Refreshing and clean, ideal for sticky heat.

fragrances.name: Éclat d'Arpège
fragrances.description: A dewy lilac and green-tea floral with soft peony and clean musk. Gentle, graceful and quietly pretty.

fragrances.name: Anaïs Anaïs
fragrances.description: A tender, powdery bouquet of lily and white flowers with a green sparkle. Innocent, soft and gently old-fashioned.

fragrances.name: Amor Amor
fragrances.description: A juicy cassis-citrus and apricot rose with a soft vanilla-amber finish. Bright, flirty and warm-hearted.

fragrances.name: Tommy Girl
fragrances.description: A bright, tea-like citrus floral with camellia and black currant. Sunny, sporty and casually all-American.

fragrances.name: Youth-Dew
fragrances.description: A dense clove-and-balsam oriental with powdery warmth and a resinous finish. Opulent, enveloping and unmistakably vintage.
pros: A true classic at a fair price
cons: Heavy and dated to modern noses

fragrances.name: Red Door
fragrances.description: A big, honeyed bouquet of red rose, orange blossom and ylang over mossy sandalwood. Dressy, confident and classically ladylike.

fragrances.name: Boss Bottled
fragrances.description: A smooth apple-cinnamon woody with a creamy sandalwood-vanilla base. Polished, warm and dependable for work.

fragrances.name: Azzaro Pour Homme
fragrances.description: A classic barbershop fougere of lavender, anise and herbs over mossy leather. Clean-shaven, confident and old-school masculine.
cons: Barbershop style feels dated to some
